name: website-chatbot
description: An AI chat widget for your website that answers from your own pages, with live takeover, email replies and an owner inbox. Runs on Cloudflare Workers with Omnara agents.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @website-chatbot/widget && npm run build -w @website-chatbot/inbox
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @website-chatbot/server
